author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Police maintained a large presence on a Scituate road late Friday after an apparent crash left debris scattered across the pavement. NBC 10 reported seeing multiple officers at the scene on Turk Hill Road. The roadway remained closed Friday night while investigators and emergency crews worked in the area.

Authorities had not released information about the number or type of vehicles involved, whether anyone was injured or what may have caused the incident. With those central details unconfirmed, the response should not be read as evidence of the crash’s severity. Images and observations from the scene established only that debris was present and traffic could not pass through the affected stretch.

Drivers should avoid the closure and use alternate routes until local officials announce that the road has reopened. The investigation was still in its early stages at the last public update, and police had not provided a timeline for clearing the scene. This report will require confirmation from Scituate authorities before any conclusions can be drawn about injuries, damage or possible charges.
dek: Multiple officers responded and debris covered part of the roadway Friday night, but authorities had not released information about injuries or vehicles involved.
headline: Police close Scituate road after apparent crash
